role: Detrended Fluctuation Analysis: computes DFA alpha1 (box sizes 4-16) and alpha2 (16-64) with R² from clean RR intervals, using log-spaced box sizes and per-box least-squares detrending; also over contiguous segments (no box spans two) and over a CleanBeatWindow whose removed beats are interpolated and whose recording breaks split it.
types: DFAAnalyzer: enum — namespace for DFA computation
DFAAnalyzer.DFAResult: struct — alpha1, alpha2?, alpha1R2, alpha2R2?
toplevel: No stored state. Box-size defaults come from HRVConstants.DFA (Utilities/Constants.swift:185-188); alpha2 additionally needs HRVConstants.MinimumBeats.forDFA = 256 beats (Constants.swift:163).

units.does: Single-series DFA: compute(segments: [rr]) with the given box ranges. Returns DFAResult for >=64 RR intervals with alpha1 over log-spaced boxes 4..min(16,n/4) and alpha2 over 16..min(64,n/4) when alpha2Exponent allows; nil when fewer than 64 beats, fewer than 3 alpha1 box sizes, or the alpha1 regression has no exponent (a degenerate series such as constant intervals). Used by the live and offline workout α1 paths and the sleep-stage classifier.

DFA for an overnight window with removed beats: compute(segments: interpolatedSegments(window)) — removed beats linearly interpolated, segments split at recording breaks. A window with no removed beat and no break gives exactly compute(_:) on its beats. Used by NonlinearAnalyzer (reported/scored α1) and WindowSelector.scoredBlock (window selection α1).

DFA over contiguous segments of one recording: joins them, integrates once (global mean), lays boxes only inside a segment (computeFluctuation), with box sizes log-spaced up to a quarter of the longest segment; regresses log F(n) on log n for alpha1, adds alpha2 when alpha2Exponent allows. One segment is the textbook single-series DFA (Peng 1995).

branches.cond: fewer than 3 alpha1 box sizes (longest segment < 24 beats, or a narrow custom range)

units.does: Turns a CleanBeatWindow into DFA input: starts a new segment wherever a recording break lies between consecutive clean beats, and inside a segment fills each run of removed beats with linear interpolation between the kept beats either side (one value per removed series index; Kubios / Lipponen & Tarvainen 2019, as LiveDFAAnalyzer.cleanRRForDFA does live). Removed beats before a segment's first or after its last kept beat are not extrapolated.

branches.cond: k > 0 and a break lies between beat k-1 and k
branches.effect: close the current segment, start a new one
append interpolated values for the removed indices between them

units.does: Whether any series index after clean beat k-1's, up to clean beat k's, follows a recording break; true when the indices are not increasing.

branches.cond: some index in (previous, next] in breaks

units.does: `missing` values evenly spaced strictly between left and right (left + (right-left)*j/(missing+1)).
Each segment's index range within the joined series.
Cumulative sum of (rr - mean) using vDSP mean: the DFA integrated profile.

branches.effect: accumulates deviation into integrated[i]; empty input yields []

units.does: Alpha2 exponent and R² over the alpha2 box sizes (boxes inside segments); nil when fewer than 3 sizes, fewer than MinimumBeats.forDFA (256) beats in the joined series, or the regression fails.

branches.cond: fewer than 3 sizes or fewer than 256 beats

units.does: Integer box sizes from lower to upper spaced by ratio 2^(1/8), deduplicated after rounding, with upper appended if missing.

branches.effect: true: appends upper so the range end is always included; false: unchanged

units.does: RMS detrended fluctuation F(n): non-overlapping boxes of boxSize laid from the start of each segment, none spanning two segments, each linearly detrended; sqrt(total residual SS / (boxes*boxSize)); 0 when no segment holds a whole box (the log-log fit then drops that size).

branches.cond: for each segment, each whole box
branches.effect: add detrended SS, count the box

units.does: Sum of squared residuals of one box after subtracting its least-squares line; falls back to the raw sum of squares when <2 points or the fit is degenerate.

branches.effect: false: returns raw sum of squares (untrended); true: residual sum

units.does: Closed-form least-squares slope/intercept of segment values against their 0-based index; nil when the denominator is 0.

Regresses log(fluctuation) on log(box size) via Statistics.linearRegression over the box sizes with a positive fluctuation (a zero one has no logarithm and is left out); nil when fewer than two remain or the regression fails, rather than an exponent of 0.
